activities.details: I levelled my Strength skill, I am now level 89.
I fought and puzzled my way through the brine rat caves to help Olaf Hradson live up to his great ancestors.
I defeated the Black Knight Titan and restored peace and happiness to the Fisher King's kingdom. I also found the Holy Grail.
I met Cyrisus and travelled the strange dream land again. Hopefully, he's still off adventuring.
By levelling up my Ranged skill, I achieved at least level 83 in all skills.
I levelled my Ranged skill, I am now level 83.
I worked with Icthlarin to gain access to the Sanctum of Rebirth; a strange temple in the Underworld.
Completing Osseous Rex has given me enough Quest Points to pass the 270 QP milestone.
I located the resting place of Osseous and watched as the old pile of bones were resurrected.
I cleaned up the City of Um's owlery, and enticed some owls back to the city.
I helped Diango to get his workshop ready for toy production in the Christmas Village.
I killed 10 King Black Dragons, which were once the biggest, meanest dragons around.
I levelled my Prayer skill, I am now level 85.
I levelled my Prayer skill, I am now level 84.
I levelled my Necromancy skill, I am now level 93.
I worked with the snow imps to help Santa bring back Christmas spirit to Gielinor.
I levelled my Necromancy skill, I am now level 92.
I levelled my Necromancy skill, I am now level 91.
I killed 25 King Black Dragons, which were once the biggest, meanest dragons around.
I levelled my Slayer skill, I am now level 93.
